# Sailfish

> A .NET performance-testing library: write benchmarks like unit tests, run them in-process or via an IDE test adapter, and get per-invocation timing distributions with statistical analysis (SailDiff), complexity estimation (ScaleFish), load testing (Trawl), and optional AI explanations (Skipper).

The complete documentation as a single file for LLM ingestion: [llms-full.txt](https://paulgradie.com/Sailfish/llms-full.txt)
